description: Retrieve product facts and save an account watchlist of Amazon ASINs by marketplace. View availability with its original observation time and subscribe to changes in ChatGPT. Watches use existing public stock observations and start no extra checks; observation gaps and intermediate changes can be missed. Size, colour and variant identity remain unknown unless established by source data. Requires a Product Information API account. This plugin does not change inventory or listings.

capabilities: Get product facts for Amazon ASINs
Get alerts in ChatGPT when availability changes
defaultPrompt: Get product details for an Amazon ASIN.
Watch an ASIN on Amazon UK and tell me when its availability changes.
Show my watchlist and the latest availability of each product.
